answer: A name without Rattlebound journeyman toymaker puppet licence is turned away at the counter, and a licence journeyman toymakers carry after toy shop audits is the reason the counter can tell. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Nobody is waved through free: a waiting period of 26 days that no payment can shorten is the price, and the pulse never covers it twice. Every ocean is counted once. The vine is checked, not assumed.
